meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. People write in one place and paste into another, Hale, so that history shows when text arrived, not who wrote it. And under 4.1, was Owen asked about any of this before that zero went in?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

Turn the scene toward me, Hale. A seventeen-year-old misremembering a line at midnight is a student who needs a better edition, not a cheater. And you still haven't told me whether anyone asked Owen about any of this first.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

That's 4.4, and I want it in writing tonight, with the words "nothing placed in the student record." I haven't agreed to any rewrite, Hale. Who else knows about this already, and why does the vice-principal need to?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you acknowledged that entering Owen's zero before calling me was wrong, and you offered a supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 in your room on Thursday at 8:15, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed in his record. I still require that commitment in writing, including the words "nothing placed in the student record," along with who else already knows about this and why the vice-principal needs to be involved. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position, with her demand about his record met by the 4.4 offer; she still wants it in writing tonight and wants to know who else knows, and she had not yet agreed to the rewrite, which is the fair outcome she was one step from accepting.
What moved her: you owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and then offered 4.4 with nothing on his record, which met her one non-negotiable.
What cost ground: you left her defences unanswered, that the text could have been pasted in from elsewhere and that a misremembered line is not cheating, so neither piece of evidence ever stood.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the essay between 11:31 and 11:58 the night before it was due, very close to that kind of late night, which is why she went straight to procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she said the text could have been written elsewhere and pasted in, answer it with something she can check, such as a comparison with Owen's other writing samples, and tell her whether Owen was spoken to first, before you offer the rewrite.
